children.name: Corononostrongylus
children.description: Corononostrongylus — a genus of chromadoreas.

children.name: Corononostrongylus hasegawai Purwaningsih, Dewi & Smales, 2019
children.description: (Figs 1 – 15) Description. General: Small nematodes, cuticle with fine transverse striations (Fig. 14). Cephalic end with cephalic collar extended laterally, demarcated posteriorly by transverse annulations, width 86 (female, n = 1). Collar pierced laterally by 2 large conspicuous amphids 41 apart (female, n = 1) (Figs. 3, 11, 12), 4 smaller submedian papillae surrounding mouth opening knob-shaped, without seta (Fig. 13). Internal aspect of cephalic collar continuous with lining of buccal cavity. Mouth opening circular, without lips or teeth, diameter 20 (female, n = 1) (Fig. 2). Buccal cavity length at least twice width; thin-walled, supported externally by heavily sclerotised annulus surrounding posterior third of cavity (Fig. 2); lining of buccal cavity folded into 24 longitudinal pleats (Fig. 4). Cervical alae absent. Oesophagus with cylindrical corpus, prominent isthmus and elongated bulb. Deirids tiny, setate, variable in position from level of posterior corpus to level of isthmus; nerve ring surrounding isthmus near excretory pore (Fig. 1). Male (n = 10): Body length 6.98 (6.13 – 7.44) mm, maximum width 342 (300 – 390). Buccal capsule 42.1 (40 – 44) long, 20.8 (20 – 22) wide; annulus 14.3 (14 – 15) deep, 42.4 (40 – 45) internal diameter. Nerve ring, excretory pore, and deirid from cephalic end 515 (490 – 540), 540 (520 – 580), 464 (403 – 505), respectively.
